nodes.name: BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference for the backend's layered architecture (routes → controllers → services → Prisma → database), covering authentication/JWT flow, error handling, validation, file uploads, external integrations (Nominatim, Immich), and reusable code patterns like buildConditionalUpdateData and asyncHandler.

nodes.name: BACKEND_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Tracks a largely completed backend refactoring initiative — standardizing controller patterns, consolidating update-data building and checklist logic, and reducing code duplication — with before/after metrics and a file-by-file analysis appendix.

nodes.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA.md
nodes.summary: Reference documentation for the 32-model Prisma/PostgreSQL schema, describing core models (User, Trip, Location, Photo, Activity, Transportation, Lodging), supporting and organizational models, the entity-linking system, enums, indexes, cascade deletes, and PostGIS usage.

nodes.name: FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: Reference documentation for the React frontend architecture, covering state management (Zustand global state + TanStack Query server state), component types (pages, managers, display, utility), Axios-based API communication, routing, styling conventions, the type system, and common hook/utility patterns such as useManagerCRUD.

nodes.name: STYLE_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Required-reading UI style guide defining the Travel Life design system — Compass Gold color palette, typography, spacing, component patterns (buttons, cards, modals, tabs, empty/loading states), dark mode conventions, animations, icons, responsive breakpoints, accessibility rules, and print styles.
